the #2 will receive 1 copy of GNS

notes.title: Big Update #1
notes.content:
After only a day after the release I fixed some bugs, improved the main menu, add sounds and music, how to play screen is now more clearer and improved, the first level have new items and also drops in frame that have reported some users to me should be resolved.

Tomorrow there will be another update with a new level, so, stay tuned! :)
